description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes.

Every Gunbreaker learns No Mercy at 1st level. For 3 rounds, until the start of your third subsequent turn, gain a +2 status bonus to gunblade Strike damage; this becomes +3 at 12th level and +4 at 18th. Load 1 cartridge immediately and gain Ready to Break for the same duration, allowing one Sonic Break if you have that feat. This bonus does not affect Continuation or save-based blasts.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.698e269ba38bcb47]{No Mercy}. The Gunbreaker console applies it.
